visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young men in white T-shirts and casual pants are kneeling on a red stage outdoors. They hold microphones and face a massive crowd of people who are also holding up phones. One man points his hand toward the audience, conducting them. The background features white event tents, green trees, and bright natural daylight. (2) The man on the left moves his arm in a sweeping motion from left to right. The crowd follows his hand with their eyes and bodies, appearing to react in unison. Yellow and red variety-show style text overlays like 'WOW' appear on the screen. (3) The man raises his fist high, and the entire crowd raises their hands and waves back enthusiastically. A large graphic 'Let's Go!' and slogan text appear as the man stands up slightly to address the screaming fans. The scene is high-energy with rapid visual feedback between the performers and the crowd.
